'''Omega group''' was a unit of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]]. They participated in the [[Assault on Edan Base|assault]] on [[Edan Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]].
